name: Google News Headlines
description: A screensaver that cycles through the headlines on Google News for the edition and section you pick, or for a search, with each story's outlet, its logo and the other outlets covering it. Select Headlines (Google News Headlines) under Screensaver > Screensaver mode.
author: MozKaboom

settings.title: Edition
settings.description: The Google News edition to show, which sets the country and language of the headlines.

settings.title: Section
settings.description: Which Google News section to show. Your country is the edition's national news.

settings.title: Search instead
settings.description: Show the latest stories about a subject, such as a team or a town, instead of a section. Leave empty to use the section.

settings.title: Number of stories
settings.description: How many headlines to cycle through, in the order Google News lists them. With several headlines per screen it rounds up to fill the last screen.

settings.title: Headlines per screen
settings.description: How many headlines to show at once. More than one stacks them on a portrait screen and puts them side by side on a landscape one.

settings.title: Time per screen
settings.description: How long each screen of headlines stays up.

settings.title: Refresh every
settings.description: How often to load the latest headlines from Google News.

settings.title: Show outlet logos
settings.description: Download each outlet's logo from Google. Turn off to show its initial instead.

settings.title: Show other coverage
settings.description: Name the other outlets covering each story, when Google News groups them.

settings.title: Show clock
settings.description: Show the time and date in the top right corner.
